legal_notes: Wagner composition public domain (d.1883; opera published in the nineteenth century). Historic piano reduction by Hans von Bülow (d.1894). Matched PDMX per-file metadata records CC0 with license_conflict=False; no conflicting rights text in the MXL. Original MuseScore page currently returns HTTP 403; no files downloaded from MuseScore.com. PDMX dataset-level CC BY 4.0 notice is distinct from the source score’s per-file CC0 dedication; credit for consulted metadata: Long, Novack, Berg-Kirkpatrick and McAuley, PDMX, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15571083. Only Artform’s independently labelled PD score is redistributed here. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
